cc:Work.dc:title: B28 corrected evaluation-protocol graphical abstract
cc:Work.dc:description: Original vector schematics, not actual fold assignments or assay images. Stored corrected data; cancer type and study are confounded. Known target feature availability; no deployment or biological-partition claim.

g.text: test; grids are split cartoons, not actual folds
107/119 retained samples are LUAD + LSCC; the retained cohort mix changes.
Cancer type × study confounded; all-six feature intersection uses target availability.
Protocol contrast, not target-blind deployment, a biological partition or a coverage guarantee.
